signature.one_line: Interview recut with giant solid-accent key words, accent/second accent cut-out cards, and a 50/50 split montage swapping proof images every ~15 frames.
unique_devices: One giant Inter-900 solid-accent key word (~14.5 % H, ~80-86 % W) per sentence with the small white lead line nested inside its ascender band
50/50 split montage: top-half example image swaps every 12-18 frames in sync with each 2-3-word caption chunk, speaker held in the bottom half
Greyscale subject cut-out with a second accent sticker outline on a solid accent card under a second accent lowercase headline, as a ~40-frame pattern interrupt
End card: profile circle on a accent disc + @handle + animated Like / Share pills
signature.why_it_works: A two-colour system makes every beat instantly recognisable; each spoken chunk gets its own proof image, and the giant key word lets a muted viewer get the thesis in three words.

hook.first_frame: seated medium shot, 3/4 profile, on a warm coloured set; small white lead words with a giant accent key word over the chest at ~55 % height within 15 frames

structure.what: start mid-thought; giant key word, then a accent cut-out headline card at frame ~19
thesis in one held shot with two giant accent key words
example 1 as a split montage: 8 proof images, one per caption chunk
example 2: cut-out headline card, then a 7-image split montage
principle restated on a accent statement card, then tighter crop on the speaker with the final key word
handle end card with animated Like button

pacing.notes: cut curve rises 24 -> 96 cuts/min in the montages then drops to ~12 for the payoff; 62 % of cuts are montage image swaps; one long held interview shot for the claim

captions.how: Inter 600 69-70 px -0.01em, centred ~49.5 % (on the divider in splits); each word fades in over 2 frames with ~1 % H drift; hard cut out

captions.when: one per sentence on interview shots
captions.how: Inter 900 ~292 px -0.03em solid accent, centred, centre y 55-59 %; lead line nested in its ascender band; fade from 40 % + scale 0.85 -> 1 over 3 frames

background_text.how: platform icon + '/ Source name' white ~1.3 % H top-left at y 4 %
second accent bold grotesque, 3 centred lines at 42-55 % height, ~3.4 % H per line

motion_graphics.how: pill press-in then pop (scale 0.9 -> 1.05 -> 1, back.out) with icon fill

cards_lists.how: solid accent card, second accent lowercase black-weight headline 3 lines top-left y 7-33 %, greyscale cut-out bottom-right with ~8 px second accent outline; ~40 frames each

silhouettes_cutouts.what: greyscale sticker cut-out with second accent outline
silhouettes_cutouts.how: subject matted, desaturated to greyscale, ~8 px second accent stroke, bottom-right overlapping the last headline line

broll_inserts.what: proof images in a split montage
broll_inserts.how: top half, hard swap every 12-18 frames, one per 2-3-word caption chunk

layout.how: divider at ~50 % H; caption on the divider

camera.what: one tighter crop on the final line
camera.how: ~120 % digital punch-in vs the opening MS, hard cut

transitions.what: hard cuts mid-speech + rapid montage swaps
transitions.how: no transitions effects; swaps are straight cuts on caption chunks

end_card.how: white with accent radial glow, profile circle on accent disc (~50 % W) at y 25-50 %, accent @handle, Like / Share pills at ~73 %

captions_spec.script: latin (Roman Hinglish for Hindi lines, English as spoken)

grouping.sync: word-by-word for lead words; key word lands on its own word
grouping.break: new caption at each new phrase; previous caption cut out

key.note: fixed size, centred horizontally; a 6-7-letter word spans ~78-86 % W

lead.lockup: nested: the lead line sits INSIDE the key word's ascender band, over the longest run of x-height-only letters, aligned to that run's edge (right-aligned over a trailing x-height run, left-aligned over a leading one)

layout.no_key_word: lead line alone, centred horizontally at ~49.5 % height
layout.split_screen: single white line centred on the divider (~50 % height)

lead.k_note: verified by rendering: Inter 600 at 70 px gives 3.39 % H / 31.9 % W for the calibration line (ref 3.2 / 32.2)

key.selection_rule: the noun/verb that carries the idea of the sentence; one per sentence
key.k_note: verified by rendering: Inter 900 at 291 px gives 'quality' 14.22 % H / 86.6 % W (ref 14.61 / 85.4); Inter runs slightly narrower-taller than the original face

animation.lead_entry: each word fades in over 2 frames as it is spoken, with ~1 % H upward drift
animation.key_entry: fades from ~40 % opacity and scales 0.85 -> 1.0 over 3 frames; measured ink height 10.9 % -> 14.4 % -> 14.7 % of H
animation.key_timing: appears ~3-5 frames after the lead line, on or slightly before the spoken key word
animation.exit: hard cut out (no fade) when the next caption starts

captions_spec.notes: Positions, sizes, colours and frame timings measured on video frames and render-verified (HyperFrames snapshot) for the lead and key tiers.

other_text_spec.when: ~2-7 % (first cut, ~40 frames) and again at ~42 % to introduce the second example
other_text_spec.text: lime #EFFA04, black-weight grotesque, lowercase 'headline / here / words!', 3 stacked lines top-left (x 10 %, y 7-33 %), each line ~6 % of H, tight leading
other_text_spec.image: speaker (or example subject) cut out in greyscale with a ~8 px lime #EFFA04 sticker outline, bottom-right, overlapping the last headline line

other_text_spec.text: yellow #F0F210, bold grotesque, Title-ish case 'Headline here', 3 centred lines at 42-55 % height, ~3.4 % of H per line
platform icon + '/ Source name', white, ~1.3 % of H, top-left at 4 % height

other_text_spec.bg: white with soft purple radial glow at the edges
other_text_spec.text: circular profile photo on a purple #791ADA disc (diameter ~50 % of W) at 25-50 % height, @handle purple bold below, two lavender pill buttons 'Like' / 'Share' with icons at ~73 % height; Like button animates (press + pop)

style.look_intent: high-contrast, saturated, warm: natural skin on a warm coloured set, fully saturated purple and lime/yellow graphics

sound.music: possible low music bed (gap level -20 dB vs speech); bed or sting audible under the end card
sfx: soft pop / tick on each montage image swap (measured cut_hit_share 0.5)
click + pop on the Like button

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Emphasis-Word Zoom
catalog_styles.role: giant purple key word per sentence

catalog_styles.name: Montage Editing
catalog_styles.role: proof images swapping per caption chunk

use_when: a podcast or interview clip with a clear principle plus 1-2 concrete examples
the user has (or can source) many example images for each example
the brand has a strong two-colour system
Hinglish or English speech that should read on mute
short clips where every second needs a new visual
avoid_when: no example imagery available - the split montage is the core device
brand colours too pale for a giant solid key word on footage
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B11 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B11.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: the solid {{ACCENT}} key word must stay >= 3:1 on the footage behind it, {{ACCENT_2}} headlines >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}})
- {{TEXT}} lead captions - default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}} giant key word - default purple #7404E6
- {{ACCENT_2}} card headlines + cut-out sticker outline - default lime #EFFA04 (statement-card text #F0F210)
- {{SURFACE}} flat card background - default purple #7D02FB
- {{CARD_BG}} end card - default white with a soft {{SURFACE}} radial glow
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} key word + card headlines - default Inter 900 (Black)
- {{FONT_BODY}} lead captions - default Inter 600 (SemiBold)
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle on the end card ({{ACCENT}} bold)
- {{LOGO}} - profile photo / logo in the end-card circle

Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

CAPTIONS
1. Latin script (Roman Hinglish for Hindi lines), as spoken; lead words sentence case, key word lowercase.
2. Lead line: 1-3 words, {{FONT_BODY}} 69-70 px, -0.01em, {{TEXT}}, no stroke/box, shadow 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35). Each word fades in over 2 frames with ~1 % H upward drift as spoken. Alone: centred at ~49.5 % H.
3. Key word: ONE per sentence (the noun/verb that carries the idea), {{FONT_DISPLAY}} ~292 px, -0.03em, solid {{ACCENT}}, no shadow/stroke, centred, centre y 55-59 % (a 6-7-letter word fills ~78-86 % W). Entry: from ~40 % opacity and scale 0.85 -> 1.0 over 3 frames, 3-5 frames after the lead line, on or just before the spoken word. Hard cut out with the next caption.
4. Nested lockup: the lead line sits inside the key word's ascender band (overlapping the key's top by ~2 % H), over the longest run of x-height letters, aligned to that run's edge (right-aligned over a trailing run e.g. x 51.5-79.9 %, y 46.8-49.4 %; left-aligned over a leading run e.g. x 16.7-48.9 %, y 50.9-54.0 %).
5. Split shots: a single {{TEXT}} line centred on the divider (~50 % H), no key word.

OTHER TEXT / EDIT DEVICES
6. Hook: start mid-thought (first word within frame 1); first cut at frame ~19 to a cut-out headline card: solid {{SURFACE}} frame, {{ACCENT_2}} lowercase {{FONT_DISPLAY}} headline 'headline / here / words!' in 3 stacked lines top-left (x 10 %, y 7-33 %, ~6 % H per line, tight leading), subject cut out in greyscale with a ~8 px {{ACCENT_2}} sticker outline bottom-right overlapping the last line; ~40 frames. Reuse the card to introduce each new example.
7. Example montage: 50/50 split, example images in the top half swapping every 12-18 frames, one per 2-3-word caption chunk, speaker held in the bottom half (~15 images over two examples).
8. Statement card (~60 frames): solid {{SURFACE}}, {{ACCENT_2}} bold 'Headline here' in 3 centred lines at 42-55 % H, ~3.4 % H per line.
9. Final line: ~120 % tighter crop on the speaker with the last giant key word.
10. Source credit (if re-cutting someone's footage): platform icon + '/ Source name', white, ~1.3 % H, top-left at y 4 %.
11. End card (~75 frames): {{CARD_BG}}, {{LOGO}} circle on an {{ACCENT}} disc (~50 % W) at y 25-50 %, {{HANDLE}} below, two lavender pill buttons 'Like' / 'Share' at ~73 % H; Like presses and pops.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, saturated, warm, natural skin; graphics fully saturated.
SOUND: voice at about -14 LUFS; soft tick/pop on montage swaps; click + pop on the Like button; low bed under the end card.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Inter; if the brand font differs, adjust px until the numbers match):
a) Render test frames over a dark area: "a particular" ({{FONT_BODY}} 69 px {{TEXT}}) and "quality" / "things" ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 292 px {{ACCENT}}).
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.1,0.44,0.9,0.66 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60,{{ACCENT}}:90" (tighten --box per line).
c) Required: "a particular" ink 3.2 % +-0.5 of H and 32.2 % +-2 of W; "quality" 14.61 % +-0.5 and 85.4 % +-2; "things" 14.69 % +-0.5 and 78.2 % +-2. For any other key word compute the expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<{{FONT_DISPLAY}}>" --word "<word>" at 292 px.
